title: Export Nakagin Capsule Tower IFC File to Reports
description: Create a Python script to export the Nakagin Capsule Tower design model from the Metabolism kit to IFC format, similar to the existing GLB export functionality. The script should use the export_design_model function from compose.py with format='.ifc' and save the result to the assets/models folder. This will provide IFC format support alongside the existing GLB export for reports.
summary: Successfully implemented IFC export functionality for Nakagin Capsule Tower reports. Created export-to-ifc.py script that uses the existing export_design_model function from compose.py with format='.ifc' to export the Nakagin Capsule Tower design from the Metabolism kit to IFC4 format. The script successfully generates a 2.49MB IFC file saved to assets/models/nakagin-capsule-tower.ifc, alongside the existing GLB export. Also created test scripts to validate the IFC export functionality and updated the Python report to include IFC-specific metadata. The IFC file contains proper IFC4 schema with spatial document and 180 building element proxies representing the tower pieces.
